changes: Initial and socket history reads share one loader, response validation and normalization path.
Abort superseded history reads and reject late results after message changes, active requests, conversation changes or disposal; same-conversation refreshes do not cancel uploads.
Do not clear active request ownership or timers when resubscribing after a language change; retained old socket callbacks are inert.
Stream previews and finalized replies share one bubble update path; existing response sanitization and finalized-response gate are retained.

preserves new messages and the same response bubble while history arrives during finished
keeps an active reply attached when the display language changes
invalidates pending history on rollover, closure and unmount, including retained socket callbacks
ignores rejected, malformed and unrelated history without cancelling a current upload

limitations: React component tests use synthetic HTTP, socket and native-drop dependencies; they are not live client or official model acceptance.

Initial test fragments were shorter than the existing 24-character stream-display buffer. Fixtures were changed to complete sentences without mocking or changing the production sanitizer; before-fix results above use the corrected final fixtures.
Business code decreased by 9 lines; permanent regression coverage adds 73 lines, so total code increased by 64 lines.
No measured improvement in real user response latency is claimed.
